Notification of Destruction of Inactive ExEd Student Records
In accordance with the state and federal regulations implementing the Individuals with Disabilities Education Act (IDEA), this is public notice of Tucson Unified School District’s intent to destroy personally identifiable information related to special education services on January 1, 2027. Please see the Exceptional Education Department page for full details.
